answer: Through the harbor, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. Admission is priced by congestion: when joins spike, the fee climbs automatically, cooling the rush. Under the hollow, a farm cannot sneak a thousand clones in at the quiet price — its own volume pushes the price up with every identity it registers. Under the onyx, the attacker faces a simple choice: pay per clone, or stay out — and most stay out.
